title: Lifelong Context Adaptation through Bidirectional Memory-Skill Learning
title_zh: 通过双向记忆-技能学习实现终身上下文适应

paragraphs.en: Lifelong LLM agents must learn from an expanding history of interactions while making each decision within a bounded context window. Memory makes past experience available, but the agent may still need to infer how to solve each new task from the retrieved records. Skills provide reusable procedures, yet may omit the task-specific facts needed to apply them. Because retrieved memory and skills shape the agent’s behavior, they also influence the experience available for future learning. We introduce MemCryst , a framework for lifelong context adaptation through bidirectional learning of memory and skills with a frozen language model. Recurring episodes stored in memory support skill creation and revision, and the interactions guided by those skills supply new memory for subsequent learning. Facts retrieved from memory and learned skills jointly form the agent’s context, while task outcomes adjust the future retrieval influence of the records actually served without rewriting their content. Across ten settings spanning embodied control, long-document reading, conversation, mathematics, and code, MemCryst leads seven reported comparisons. On ALFWorld, joint serving achieves 63.17 % 63.17\% success, compared with 59.83 % 59.83\% for memory-only and 50.50 % 50.50\% for skill-only serving. Code is available at https://github.com/tianyi0216/Memcryst.git .
paragraphs.zh: 终身大语言模型智能体必须在不断扩展的交互历史中学习，同时在有限的上下文窗口内做出每一个决策。 记忆使过去的经验可供使用，但智能体可能仍需要从检索到的记录中推断如何解决每个新任务。 技能提供了可复用的程序，却可能遗漏应用它们所需的任务特定事实。 由于检索到的记忆和技能塑造了智能体的行为，它们也会影响未来学习可用的经验。 我们提出 MemCryst，一个在冻结语言模型下通过记忆与技能的双向学习实现终身上下文自适应的框架。 存储在记忆中的重复事件支持技能的创建与修订，而这些技能引导的交互又为后续学习提供新的记忆。 从记忆中检索的事实与习得的技能共同构成智能体的上下文，而任务结果会调整实际被使用的记录在未来的检索影响力，而无需改写其内容。 在涵盖具身控制、长文档阅读、对话、数学和代码的十种设置中，MemCryst 在七项已报告的对比中领先。 在 ALFWorld 上，联合服务达到 63.17 % 63.17\% 的成功率，而仅用记忆为 59.83 % 59.83\%，仅用技能为 50.50 % 50.50\%。 代码可在 https://github.com/tianyi0216/Memcryst.git 获取。

paragraphs.en: LLM agents deployed over long periods encounter tasks whose solutions depend on earlier experience ( Zhao et al., 2023 ; Yan et al., 2026 ) . An agent may need to recall an entity’s properties, reuse a successful procedure, or avoid a failure that occurred many interactions earlier. When the language model remains frozen, this experience can affect decisions only through the context supplied to it. The interaction history grows throughout deployment, while the context available for any one decision remains bounded. Lifelong adaptation therefore requires the agent to extract reusable decision structure from this history, preserve evidence for the current task, and adjust retrieval as further outcomes become available. We study how an agent can learn this external state online so that past experience improves subsequent decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 长期部署的大语言模型智能体会遇到一些任务，其解决方案依赖于早先的经验（Zhao et al., 2023；Yan et al., 2026）。 智能体可能需要回忆某个实体的属性、复用某个成功的流程，或避免许多次交互之前发生过的一次失败。 当语言模型保持冻结时，这些经验只能通过提供给它的上下文来影响决策。 交互历史在部署过程中不断增长，而用于任何一次决策的可用上下文却是有界的。 因此，终身适应要求智能体从这一历史中提取可复用的决策结构，为当前任务保留证据，并随着更多结果的出现而调整检索。 我们研究智能体如何在线学习这种外部状态，使过去的经验能够改进后续的决策。

paragraphs.en: Previous work has used external memory to store past interactions, facts, or compressed notes for retrieval on later tasks ( Xu et al., 2025 ; Fang et al., 2026a ; Liu et al., 2026 ) . These records provide evidence from earlier experience, but the agent may still need to work out a procedure each time a similar task recurs. Other approaches learn reusable procedures, or skills, from experience to guide later tasks ( Wang et al., 2024a ; Zheng et al., 2025a ; Ni et al., 2026 ) , but these procedures may omit the task-specific facts and constraints needed to apply them. Recent systems combine memory and skills: MUSE-AutoSkill organizes experience around evolving skills, while MSCE uses stored evidence and feedback to guide skill development ( Lin et al., 2026 ; Tang et al., 2026 ) . Maintaining both, however, does not by itself ensure that the retrieved facts and skills are useful for the current task. A fact may be correct but irrelevant, and a skill may not fit the current situation. Failure can therefore inform future retrieval without establishing that the retrieved content should be rewritten. Meanwhile, skill-guided interactions supply new memory for subsequent skill revision. The challenge is to learn from this experience while using task outcomes to adjust which facts and skills enter later contexts.
paragraphs.zh: 已有工作利用外部记忆来存储过往交互、事实或压缩笔记，以便在后续任务中检索（Xu et al., 2025; Fang et al., 2026a; Liu et al., 2026）。 这些记录提供了来自早期经验的证据，但每当类似任务再次出现时，智能体仍可能需要重新设计一套流程。 另一些方法则从经验中学习可复用的流程或技能，以指导后续任务（Wang et al., 2024a; Zheng et al., 2025a; Ni et al., 2026），但这些流程可能遗漏应用它们所需的任务特定事实和约束。 最近的系统将记忆与技能相结合：MUSE-AutoSkill 围绕不断演化的技能来组织经验，而 MSCE 则利用存储的证据和反馈来指导技能发展（Lin et al., 2026; Tang et al., 2026）。 然而，同时维护这两者本身并不能确保检索到的事实和技能对当前任务有用。 一个事实可能正确但不相关，一个技能也可能不适合当前情境。 因此，失败可以为未来的检索提供信息，但并不能表明检索到的内容应当被改写。 与此同时，技能引导的交互为后续的技能修订提供了新的记忆。 挑战在于如何从这些经验中学习，同时利用任务结果来调整哪些事实和技能进入后续的上下文。

paragraphs.en: We introduce MemCryst to adapt context through bidirectional memory–skill learning. Even with frozen model parameters, retrieved context changes the agent’s actions and thus the experiences available for subsequent learning. MemCryst stores experience in memory as episodic records and typed facts, and consolidates recurring episodes into conditional skills. At deployment, facts provide task-relevant evidence alongside the procedures supplied by skills. Skill-guided interactions then enter memory and support later skill revision, completing the reverse path from skills to memory through behavior. In parallel, each task outcome updates the retrieval influence of the facts and skills actually served. Content construction draws on accumulated experience, while outcome return adjusts future use without regenerating record text. Both processes adapt the agent’s context while leaving the language model frozen.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 MemCryst，通过双向的记忆—技能学习来适配上下文。 即使模型参数被冻结，检索到的上下文也会改变智能体的动作，从而改变可供后续学习使用的经验。 MemCryst 将经验以情节记录和类型化事实的形式存储在记忆中，并将反复出现的情节整合为条件化技能。 在部署时，事实与技能所提供的操作步骤一起提供与任务相关的证据。 技能引导的交互随后进入记忆，并支持后续的技能修订，从而完成从技能到记忆、经由行为的反向路径。 与此同时，每个任务结果都会更新实际被调用的那些事实和技能的检索影响力。 内容构建利用积累的经验，而结果回传则在不重新生成记录文本的情况下调整未来的使用。 这两个过程都能适配智能体的上下文，同时保持语言模型处于冻结状态。

paragraphs.en: External memory preserves experience in forms ranging from distilled guidance to source-linked evidence. ExpeL, SAGE, and Dynamic Cheatsheet retain experience as insights, reflections, or strategies ( Zhao et al., 2023 ; Liang et al., 2026 ; Suzgun et al., 2025 ) . A-Mem organizes linked notes, while TriMem combines source-linked dialogue with atomic facts and profiles ( Xu et al., 2025 ; Sun et al., 2026 ) . LightMem and SimpleMem compress evidence through sleep-time and within-session consolidation, respectively ( Fang et al., 2026a ; Liu et al., 2026 ) . Repeated textual consolidation can, however, discard useful details ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) . MemCryst retains episode evidence for skill learning alongside independently retrievable typed facts.
paragraphs.zh: 外部记忆以多种形式保存经验，从提炼后的指南到带来源链接的证据。 ExpeL、SAGE 和 Dynamic Cheatsheet 将经验以洞见、反思或策略的形式保留（Zhao et al., 2023；Liang et al., 2026；Suzgun et al., 2025）。 A-Mem 组织关联笔记，而 TriMem 将带来源链接的对话与原子事实和用户画像相结合（Xu et al., 2025；Sun et al., 2026）。 LightMem 和 SimpleMem 分别通过睡眠期整合和会话内整合来压缩证据（Fang et al., 2026a；Liu et al., 2026）。 然而，重复的文本整合可能丢弃有用的细节（Zhang et al., 2026a）。 MemCryst 为技能学习保留情节证据，同时保留可独立检索的类型化事实。

sents.en: External memory preserves experience in forms ranging from distilled guidance to source-linked evidence.
sents.zh: 外部记忆以多种形式保存经验，从提炼后的指南到带来源链接的证据。

sents.en: ExpeL, SAGE, and Dynamic Cheatsheet retain experience as insights, reflections, or strategies ( Zhao et al., 2023 ; Liang et al., 2026 ; Suzgun et al., 2025 ) .

sents.en: A-Mem organizes linked notes, while TriMem combines source-linked dialogue with atomic facts and profiles ( Xu et al., 2025 ; Sun et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: A-Mem 组织关联笔记，而 TriMem 将带来源链接的对话与原子事实和用户画像相结合（Xu et al., 2025；Sun et al., 2026）。

sents.zh: LightMem 和 SimpleMem 分别通过睡眠期整合和会话内整合来压缩证据（Fang et al., 2026a；Liu et al., 2026）。

sents.en: Repeated textual consolidation can, however, discard useful details ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) .

sents.en: MemCryst retains episode evidence for skill learning alongside independently retrievable typed facts.
sents.zh: MemCryst 为技能学习保留情节证据，同时保留可独立检索的类型化事实。

paragraphs.en: Voyager and SkillWeaver develop executable skills through interaction and refine them through execution feedback or testing ( Wang et al., 2024a ; Zheng et al., 2025a ) , while EvoPool evolves executable annotator pools using validation feedback ( Xu et al., 2026a ) . Agent Workflow Memory abstracts workflows from trajectories, while Trace2Skill combines trace-level lessons into portable skill files ( Wang et al., 2024b ; Ni et al., 2026 ) . MemP combines trajectories with abstract scripts and supports revision after failure, and AutoSkill maintains versioned skills from user interactions ( Fang et al., 2026b ; Yang et al., 2026 ) . In MemCryst , revision draws on both new episodes and the supporting episodes of an existing skill. It preserves the skill’s identity and accumulated use statistics, while the revised procedure can be served alongside independently retrieved facts.
paragraphs.zh: Voyager 和 SkillWeaver 通过交互开发可执行技能，并借助执行反馈或测试对其进行改进（Wang et al., 2024a；Zheng et al., 2025a），而 EvoPool 则利用验证反馈来进化可执行的标注者池（Xu et al., 2026a）。 Agent Workflow Memory 从轨迹中抽象出工作流，而 Trace2Skill 将轨迹级的经验整合为可移植的技能文件（Wang et al., 2024b；Ni et al., 2026）。 MemP 将轨迹与抽象脚本相结合，并支持失败后的修订，而 AutoSkill 则从用户交互中维护带版本的技能（Fang et al., 2026b；Yang et al., 2026）。 在 MemCryst 中，修订同时借鉴新的情节和现有技能所依赖的支撑情节。 它保留技能的标识和累积的使用统计信息，同时修订后的流程可以与独立检索到的事实一起提供服务。

paragraphs.en: For long-input processing, MemAgent repeatedly updates bounded textual memory, while Multi-Head Recurrent Memory updates one memory head at a time ( Yu et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026 ) . The Sleep paradigm consolidates knowledge into model parameters through distillation and replay ( Behrouz et al., 2026 ) . MemCryst maintains experience across deployment events in external stores, using a frozen model for both task execution and skill consolidation.
paragraphs.zh: 在长输入处理中，MemAgent 反复更新有界文本记忆，而多头循环记忆则一次更新一个记忆头（Yu et al., 2025；Li et al., 2026）。 Sleep 范式通过蒸馏和重放将知识巩固到模型参数中（Behrouz et al., 2026）。 MemCryst 在外部存储中跨部署事件维护经验，使用冻结模型执行任务和巩固技能。

sents.zh: 在长输入处理中，MemAgent 反复更新有界文本记忆，而多头循环记忆则一次更新一个记忆头（Yu et al., 2025；Li et al., 2026）。

sents.zh: Sleep 范式通过蒸馏和重放将知识巩固到模型参数中（Behrouz et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: Memory-R1 learns memory management and use through reinforcement learning, whereas Live-Evo adjusts experience weights from reward differences between executions with and without memory ( Yan et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) . MUSE-AutoSkill maintains skill-specific usage notes and revises skills from execution feedback ( Lin et al., 2026 ) . MSCE uses reflection-weighted terminal values of traces to guide retrieval and skill evolution, with skill reliability also governing retrieval ( Tang et al., 2026 ) . EvoChamber extends coevolution to memories, team collaboration, and population structure ( Zhang et al., 2026c ) ; UCoE co-evolves verifiers with agent harness state ( Xu et al., 2026b ) , and EvalResearchBench studies autonomous evaluator construction ( Zhang et al., 2026d ) . In MemCryst , skill-guided interactions supply episodes for subsequent skill revision. Unlike Live-Evo’s paired comparison, return uses the observed task outcome and applies it only to records actually served. It updates fact exposure and success counts and skill utilities without rewriting their content. Episode-based consolidation remains responsible for skill creation and revision.
paragraphs.zh: Memory-R1 通过强化学习来学习记忆的管理与使用，而 Live-Evo 则根据有记忆与无记忆执行之间的奖励差异来调整经验权重（Yan et al., 2026；Zhang et al., 2026b）。 MUSE-AutoSkill 维护特定技能的使用说明，并根据执行反馈修订技能（Lin et al., 2026）。 MSCE 使用轨迹的反思加权终端价值来指导检索与技能演化，技能可靠性同时也用于约束检索（Tang et al., 2026）。 EvoChamber 将协同演化扩展到记忆、团队协作与种群结构（Zhang et al., 2026c）；UCoE 使验证器与智能体框架状态协同演化（Xu et al., 2026b），EvalResearchBench 则研究自主评估器的构建（Zhang et al., 2026d）。 在 MemCryst 中，技能引导的交互为后续的技能修订提供经验片段。 与 Live-Evo 的成对比较不同，回报使用观测到的任务结果，并且只应用于实际被调用过的记录。 它更新事实的暴露次数与成功次数以及技能效用，而不改写其内容。 基于经验片段的整合仍然负责技能的创建与修订。

paragraphs.en: The outcome-return operator B B updates the retrieval statistics of exposed facts and skills without rewriting their content. The content update operator G G combines memory writing after each event with skill consolidation at scheduled sleep boundaries. Return precedes new writes, so records created from the current outcome cannot receive return from that outcome. Appendices A.3 and A.5 specify the event protocol, eligibility rules, and context assembly.
paragraphs.zh: 结果回报算子 B B 在不重写内容的情况下更新已暴露事实与技能的检索统计信息。 内容更新算子 G G 将每次事件后的记忆写入与在预定的睡眠边界进行的技能巩固相结合。 回报先于新的写入，因此由当前结果创建的记录无法接收来自该结果的回报。 附录 A.3 和 A.5 规定了事件协议、资格规则与上下文组装。

paragraphs.en: For each cluster, a frozen LM synthesizes a conditional procedure from a small subset of high-weight episodes. Instance-specific values become parameter slots, while applicability conditions specify when the procedure should be used. A separate audit in a fresh context checks the proposal’s parametricity, coverage, and scope against the selected episodes. Each admitted skill retains links to all episodes in its source cluster for later revision.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个聚类，冻结的语言模型从高权重回合的一个小子集中合成出一个条件化程序。 实例特定的值变成参数槽位，而适用性条件则规定该程序应在何时使用。 一个在全新上下文中进行的独立审计会针对所选回合检查该提案的参数性、覆盖范围和适用范围。 每个被采纳的技能都会保留指向其来源聚类中所有回合的链接，以便后续修订。

paragraphs.en: After a proposal passes the initial audit, G G checks whether its complete capability key matches an existing skill. This key specifies the verb family, target type, affordance, and output. Unmatched proposals enter the catalog unless blocked by the adapter’s duplicate-slug guard. For a match, G G combines the new cluster with the existing skill’s supporting episodes, synthesizes a revision, and replaces the skill only after a second audit accepts it. An accepted revision preserves the skill identity and accumulated utility while extending its links to supporting episodes. Later experience can therefore refine an existing procedure rather than merely expand the catalog. Appendix A.4 gives the ordered update, matching fields, and audit details.
paragraphs.zh: 提案通过初始审计后，G G 会检查其完整能力键是否与某个现有技能匹配。 该键指定了动词族、目标类型、可供性和输出。 未匹配的提案会进入目录，除非被适配器的重复 slug 保护机制阻止。 若匹配成功，G G 会将新集群与现有技能的支持性情节合并，综合出一个修订版本，并且只有在第二次审计接受后才替换该技能。 被接受的修订会保留技能身份和累积效用，同时扩展其与支持性情节的链接。 因此，后续经验可以改进现有程序，而不仅仅是扩充目录。 附录 A.4 给出了有序更新、匹配字段和审计细节。

paragraphs.en: Skills shape the agent’s subsequent interactions, which supply new evidence for memory and later skill revision. Together with retrieved facts and current observations, they condition τ t \tau_{t} in Eq. 4 . For example, a cleaning skill can guide the agent to clean an object before placing it at the destination. The resulting episode preserves evidence of how the procedure was applied, together with an outcome diagnosis and lessons for later revision. Appendix D illustrates this path with saved cleaning episodes and skill snapshots.

paragraphs.en: Here 𝒲 E \mathcal{W}_{E} writes the episode’s evidence, diagnosis, and lesson, while 𝒳 F \mathcal{X}_{F} extracts facts and may return none. Matching facts add recurrence support and provenance to the existing record for the same entity, scope, and claim, preserving its text and exposure statistics. Unmatched facts create new records. The new episode is available for subsequent skill mining, including a sleep pass at the current boundary. Episodes thus support continued skill learning, while facts remain independently retrievable for later tasks. Skills influence new memory through behavior without directly editing fact text.

paragraphs.en: Benchmarks and baselines. We evaluate ten settings across five domains. ALFWorld covers embodied control ( Shridhar et al., 2021 ) , while RULER and BABILong cover long-document reading ( Hsieh et al., 2024 ; Kuratov et al., 2024 ) . We evaluate conversation memory on LoCoMo, LongMemEval, and name-substituted DialSim ( Maharana et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Kim et al., 2024 ) . MATH-hard tests mathematical reasoning ( Hendrycks et al., 2021 ) , while MBPP, CodeContests, and LCB+ cover code generation ( Austin et al., 2021 ; Li et al., 2022 ; Jain et al., 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2025b ) . Our main baselines are ReAct without persistent state ( Yao et al., 2023 ) , experience-based ExpeL and MemP ( Zhao et al., 2023 ; Fang et al., 2026b ) , and the memory systems SimpleMem and LightMem ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Fang et al., 2026a ) .
paragraphs.zh: 基准与基线。 我们在五个领域上评估十种设置。 ALFWorld 覆盖具身控制（Shridhar et al., 2021），而 RULER 和 BABILong 覆盖长文档阅读（Hsieh et al., 2024；Kuratov et al., 2024）。 我们在 LoCoMo、LongMemEval 和经过名称替换的 DialSim 上评估对话记忆（Maharana et al., 2024；Wu et al., 2025；Kim et al., 2024）。 MATH-hard 测试数学推理（Hendrycks et al., 2021），而 MBPP、CodeContests 和 LCB+ 覆盖代码生成（Austin et al., 2021；Li et al., 2022；Jain et al., 2025；Zheng et al., 2025b）。 我们的主要基线是无持久状态的 ReAct（Yao et al., 2023）、基于经验的 ExpeL 和 MemP（Zhao et al., 2023；Fang et al., 2026b），以及记忆系统 SimpleMem 和 LightMem（Liu et al., 2026；Fang et al., 2026a）。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation. We report prequential mean reward, scoring each task before its interaction updates the external state and excluding standalone evidence-ingestion events. Benchmark metrics include success rate, recall, token F1, exact match, and unit-test reward. All scores are percentages, and absolute differences are in percentage points, denoted by pp. See Appendix C for detailed settings and aggregation rules.
paragraphs.zh: 评估。 我们报告前置序贯平均奖励，在每个任务与外部状态交互更新之前进行评分，并排除独立的证据摄入事件。 基准指标包括成功率、召回率、token F1、精确匹配和单元测试奖励。 所有分数均为百分比，绝对差异以百分点表示，记作 pp。 详细设置与聚合规则见附录 C。

paragraphs.en: MemCryst leads seven of ten settings. Table 1 reports an Overall of 52.26 % 52.26\% for MemCryst , compared with 39.92 % 39.92\% for SimpleMem, the strongest baseline under this aggregate. MemCryst leads ALFWorld and BABILong and ranks second to ExpeL on RULER. In ALFWorld, skills specify action sequences, while facts supply the object and environment information needed to apply them. The joint-serving ablation below tests this complementarity. The largest gains over ReAct occur in conversation memory, where MemCryst also exceeds SimpleMem on all three settings. On name-substituted DialSim, it reaches 74.24 % 74.24\% against SimpleMem’s 47.85 % 47.85\% . Here, retrieval supplies names, dates, and events that a general procedure cannot recover from the question alone. The larger gain after name substitution in Appendix B.7 further supports this role for deployment-specific evidence. Benefits are smaller in mathematics and code, where ExpeL leads MBPP and CodeContests and MemCryst falls below ReAct on MBPP. Appendix B.8 shows a modest MBPP gain when episodes are retained for skill learning but withheld from the actor, supporting selective context construction. See Appendices B.4 and B.5 for additional baseline comparisons.
paragraphs.zh: MemCryst 在十项设置中的七项上领先。 表 1 报告 MemCryst 的总体得分为 52.26 % 52.26\%，而 SimpleMem 为 39.92 % 39.92\%，后者是此汇总下最强的基线。 MemCryst 在 ALFWorld 和 BABILong 上领先，在 RULER 上仅次于 ExpeL 排名第二。 在 ALFWorld 中，技能规定动作序列，而事实提供应用这些动作序列所需的物体与环境信息。 下方的联合服务消融实验检验了这种互补性。 相对于 ReAct 的最大提升出现在对话记忆中，MemCryst 在该任务的全部三个设置上也超过了 SimpleMem。 在替换姓名后的 DialSim 上，它达到 74.24 % 74.24\%，而 SimpleMem 为 47.85 % 47.85\%。 在这里，检索提供姓名、日期和事件，这些信息无法仅凭问题由一般性程序恢复。 附录 B.7 中姓名替换后更大的提升进一步支持了部署特定证据的这一作用。 在数学和代码方面的收益较小，其中 ExpeL 在 MBPP 和 CodeContests 上领先，而 MemCryst 在 MBPP 上低于 ReAct。 附录 B.8 显示，当情节被保留用于技能学习但不提供给 actor 时，MBPP 有适度提升，这支持了选择性上下文构建。 更多基线比较见附录 B.4 和 B.5。

paragraphs.en: A shared state improves overall performance under interleaving. On the interleaved stream in Table 2 , MemCryst uses one shared, domain-scoped state to raise mean performance from 28.30 % 28.30\% to 44.50 % 44.50\% across 1,018 queries in five domains. It retains improvements on both document slices and about 80 % 80\% of the isolated LoCoMo gain. The shared system scores 4.00 4.00 points below the specialist mean of 48.50 % 48.50\% , while exceeding the separate specialists on BABILong and MBPP. These results show that one evolving state can supply useful context as deployment alternates between domains. See Appendix C.2 for the stream composition and specialist settings.
paragraphs.zh: 共享状态在交错场景下提升了整体性能。 在表 2 的交错数据流上，MemCryst 使用一个共享的、按领域划分作用域的状态，将五个领域共 1,018 条查询的平均性能从 28.30 % 28.30\% 提升至 44.50 % 44.50\%。 它在两个文档切片上都保持了提升，并保留了约 80 % 80\% 的独立 LoCoMo 收益。 共享系统的得分比专家智能体的均值 48.50 % 48.50\% 低 4.00 4.00 分，但在 BABILong 和 MBPP 上超过了各自独立的专家智能体。 这些结果表明，当部署在多个领域之间交替时，一个不断演化的状态能够提供有用的上下文。 数据流的构成与专家智能体的设置见附录 C.2。

paragraphs.en: Ablation studies. On the same ALFWorld stream in Table 4 a, joint serving achieves 63.17 % 63.17\% success, compared with 59.83 % 59.83\% for memory-only and 50.50 % 50.50\% for skill-only serving. Memory-only retains memory writing, fact retrieval, and fact return but disables skills. Skill-only serving retains internal memory for skill learning while withholding memory from the actor’s context. Each configuration learns from its own trajectories. Allowing skill revision adds 1.17 1.17 points over the 62.00 % 62.00\% score obtained with admitted skill text frozen. The no-revision control still creates and serves skills and updates their utilities, so this comparison tests the value of continued procedure revision.
paragraphs.zh: 消融实验。 在表 4a 的同一 ALFWorld 流上，联合服务达到 63.17 % 63.17\% 的成功率，相比之下，仅记忆服务为 59.83 % 59.83\%，仅技能服务为 50.50 % 50.50\%。 仅记忆配置保留记忆写入、事实检索和事实返回，但禁用技能。 仅技能服务为技能学习保留内部记忆，但不将记忆提供给执行者的上下文。 每种配置都从自己的轨迹中学习。 允许技能修订比在已接纳技能文本冻结情况下获得的 62.00 % 62.00\% 分数高出 1.17 1.17 分。 不修订对照组仍然会创建并服务技能，并更新其效用，因此该对比检验的是持续过程修订的价值。

paragraphs.en: Skill revision continues after catalog growth stops. Figure 2 records 154 accepted revisions over the 600-task stream, with all five final skills present by cycle 2. The skills are served 496 times, including 338 deployments on successful tasks. For example, the earlier lamp-examination skill in Figure 10 accepts lamp visibility or object acquisition as its trigger. The later version requires both lamp visibility and possession of the object. This tighter precondition illustrates how episodes from skill-guided behavior can refine the procedure supplied in later contexts under the same skill identity. See Appendices B.6 and D for lifecycle analyses and further saved examples.
paragraphs.zh: 技能修订在目录增长停止后仍在继续。 图 2 记录了在 600 个任务的流中共有 154 次被接受的修订，且全部五个最终技能在第 2 轮循环时已全部出现。 这些技能被服务了 496 次，其中包括在成功任务上的 338 次部署。 例如，图 10 中较早的灯检查技能将灯的可见性或物体获取作为其触发条件。 较晚的版本则同时要求灯的可见性和拥有该物体。 这一更严格的前提条件说明了来自技能引导行为的情节如何在相同技能身份下，对后续情境中提供的流程进行精化。 生命周期分析及更多保存的示例见附录 B.6 和 D。

paragraphs.en: Relevant selection improves success with a frozen state. To separate context use from online learning, we freeze one learned state and compare three serving conditions on the same 100 held-out ALFWorld tasks. Figure 3 shows 75 % 75\% success for MemCryst , versus 58 % 58\% with approximately length-matched random records. Random selection also matches record types, so this contrast tests which existing facts and skills enter context. Keeping the facts fixed and replacing skills with retrieved episodes yields 72 % 72\% . The skill-based context uses about 62 % 62\% fewer injected tokens and 29 % 29\% fewer actor input tokens than episode replacement. This second contrast supports representing recurring experience as compact procedures, without establishing an accuracy advantage over episodic context. Appendix B.3 explains the protocol.
paragraphs.zh: 相关的选择可以在冻结状态下提升成功率。 为了区分上下文使用与在线学习，我们冻结一个学习到的状态，并在相同的 100 个保留 ALFWorld 任务上比较三种服务条件。 图 3 显示 MemCryst 的成功率为 75 % 75\%，而与长度大致匹配的随机记录为 58 % 58\%。 随机选择同样匹配记录类型，因此这一对比检验的是哪些既有事实和技能进入上下文。 保持事实不变并用检索到的情节替换技能，成功率为 72 % 72\%。 与情节替换相比，基于技能的上下文注入的 token 约少 62 % 62\%，actor 输入 token 约少 29 % 29\%。 第二个对比支持将反复出现的经验表示为紧凑的程序化技能，但并未确立相对于情节上下文的准确率优势。 附录 B.3 解释了该协议。

paragraphs.en: MemCryst adapts a frozen LLM by learning the evidence and procedures supplied in its bounded context. Recurring episodes support skill creation and revision, while skills and retrieved facts guide behavior that supplies new memory for subsequent learning. Outcome return separately adjusts which facts and skills are favored in later retrieval. Across the evaluated settings, benefits are strongest in conversation and mixed in code. ALFWorld ablations support joint serving and show interaction between return channels. Frozen-state controls show higher success with relevant record selection and fewer injected tokens with skills than with episodic context. Together, these results support bidirectional memory–skill learning as a way to turn accumulated experience into useful context without updating model parameters.
paragraphs.zh: MemCryst 通过在其有界上下文中学习所提供的证据与流程来适配一个冻结的 LLM。 反复出现的情节支持技能的创建与修订，而技能与检索到的事实则引导行为，行为又为后续学习提供新的记忆。 结果回报会单独调整哪些事实与技能在后续检索中更受青睐。 在所评估的各类场景中，收益在对话中最强，在代码中则好坏参半。 ALFWorld 的消融实验支持联合服务，并显示各回报通道之间存在交互。 冻结状态对照实验表明，通过相关记录选择可获得更高的成功率，且使用技能比使用情节上下文需要注入的 token 更少。 总之，这些结果支持双向记忆—技能学习，将其作为一种无需更新模型参数即可把积累的经验转化为有用上下文的方法。

paragraphs.en: Outcome return assigns the same task outcome to every served fact and skill, so it does not identify individual causal contributions or estimate factual truth. It relies on an observed success signal, and robustness to erroneous feedback remains untested. The state and co-serving analyses are descriptive. The LM-based skill audit screens proposals against selected episodes but does not guarantee correctness. Our interleaved evaluation uses domain-scoped retrieval and does not establish transfer of learned skills to unseen domains.
paragraphs.zh: 结果回报将相同的任务结果分配给每个被服务的资源和技能，因此它无法识别个体的因果贡献或估计事实真伪。 它依赖观察到的成功信号，而对错误反馈的鲁棒性尚未经过检验。 状态与共同服务分析是描述性的。 基于语言模型的技能审计仅针对选定的片段筛选提案，但并不保证正确性。 我们的交错式评估使用领域范围内的检索，并未证明所学技能能够迁移到未见过的领域。

paragraphs.en: This study evaluates agents on existing benchmarks and does not recruit human participants or release a new foundation model or scraped dataset. Persistent records and provenance can help users inspect adaptation and diagnose repeated errors, but they can also retain sensitive or false information. Repeated retrieval may amplify biases in either stored content or outcome feedback. Because the return mechanism rewards task success, it should not be interpreted as validating a claim’s accuracy or an action’s appropriateness.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究在现有基准上对智能体进行评估，不招募人类受试者，也不发布新的基础模型或抓取的数据集。 持久记录与来源信息可以帮助用户检查适应过程并诊断重复出现的错误，但也可能保留敏感或虚假的信息。 反复检索可能会放大存储内容或结果反馈中存在的偏见。 由于回报机制以任务成功为奖励依据，因此不应将其解读为对某一说法的准确性或某一行为的恰当性的认可。

paragraphs.en: Deployments with user data should separate stores by user and domain, restrict access, and provide retention and deletion controls. Users should be able to inspect and contest stored information, with human review before consequential actions. These deployment safeguards require separate validation, and our benchmark results do not establish real-world safety.
paragraphs.zh: 包含用户数据的部署应按用户和领域分离存储、限制访问，并提供保留与删除控制。 用户应能够查看并对存储的信息提出异议，在产生重大影响的操作之前应有人工审核。 这些部署层面的保障措施需要单独验证，我们的基准测试结果并不能证明真实世界中的安全性。

paragraphs.en: This appendix specifies the records and updates that turn stored experience into context for later decisions. It follows the online loop from retrieval through outcome return and memory writing to skill consolidation, then derives the properties of the outcome statistics used in retrieval.

paragraphs.en: For an episode, q e q_{e} is task evidence, δ e \delta_{e} is the outcome diagnosis, and ℓ e \ell_{e} is the reusable lesson. The lifecycle field a e ∈ { active , archived } a_{e}\in\{\mathrm{active},\mathrm{archived}\} controls ordinary wake retrieval. For a fact, ent f \operatorname{ent}_{f} , φ f \varphi_{f} , and z f z_{f} are its entity, claim, and type. The field c f c_{f} records recurrence support and P f P_{f} records provenance from source events. For a skill, χ s \chi_{s} contains its applicability conditions and capability key, ψ s \psi_{s} is its procedure, and 𝒜 s \mathcal{A}_{s} contains the IDs of its accepted supporting episodes. Each record carries a domain or stream scope stamp ε v \varepsilon_{v} . paragraphs.en: Algorithm A.3 applies outcome return before memory writing and consolidates skills at scheduled sleep boundaries. The runner appends the episode, applies return to previously served facts, writes new facts, and then applies return to previously served skills. This order produces the same state as B B followed by G write G_{\rm write} : outcome return does not update episodes, fact return precedes new fact insertion, and skill return does not change memory content. Skill consolidation follows all four substeps at a sleep boundary. Because the action context is fixed before o t o_{t} arrives, these updates influence only later decisions.

paragraphs.en: Insertion creates a fresh identity whose ancestry contains every episode in C C . Replacement regenerates the incumbent’s text and capability fields while preserving its identifier, creation time, and utility after outcome return. It also combines the old and new ancestry, so evidence for an existing capability supports revision under the same skill identity. An accepted insertion or revision archives the current cluster from ordinary wake retrieval. Some adapters also apply a duplicate-slug guard that archives the cluster even when it intercepts an insertion and leaves the catalog unchanged. These episodes remain stored for provenance and are reactivated at the next sleep boundary.
paragraphs.zh: 插入会创建一个新的身份，其祖先链包含 C C 中的每一个情节记录。 替换会在结果返回后重新生成现有条目的文本和能力字段，同时保留其标识符、创建时间和效用。 它还会合并旧的和新的祖先链，因此已有能力的证据可以支持在同一个技能身份下进行修订。 被接受的插入或修订会将当前集群从常规的唤醒检索中归档。 一些适配器还会应用重复 slug 保护机制，即使它拦截了一次插入且未更改目录，也会将该集群归档。 这些情节记录仍被保留以供溯源，并在下一个睡眠边界处被重新激活。

paragraphs.en: Retrieval determines which parts of the evolving state can affect the next decision. The retriever first checks scope and applicability, then ranks eligible records by relevance and retrieval influence. An episode is eligible for ordinary wake retrieval only when it is active and scope compatible. Archived episodes remain stored for provenance and later mining. A fact must satisfy the adapter’s scope, type, and minimum support filters. For skills, it extracts the four-field capability key defined in Section A.4 and first searches for an exact match. If none exists, the main capability route relaxes the affordance requirement and then both the verb and affordance requirements. This route does not fall back to global cosine retrieval. All routing choices and thresholds are fixed before a stream begins, and K X = 0 K_{X}=0 disables channel X X .
paragraphs.zh: 检索决定演化状态中哪些部分能够影响下一个决策。 检索器首先检查范围与适用性，然后按相关性和检索影响对合格记录进行排序。 只有当片段处于活跃状态且范围兼容时，才有资格参与常规唤醒检索。 已归档的片段仍会被存储，用于溯源和后续挖掘。 一条事实必须满足适配器的范围、类型和最小支持度过滤条件。 对于技能，它会提取 A.4 节中定义的四字段能力键，并首先搜索精确匹配。 如果不存在精确匹配，主能力路由会放宽可供性要求，然后再同时放宽动词和可供性要求。 该路由不会回退到全局余弦检索。 所有路由选择和阈值都在数据流开始之前固定，且 K_X = 0 会禁用通道 X。

paragraphs.en: Settings. We reconstruct the original 600-game pool from ALFWorld’s train ordering and apply four global permutations with NumPy ( Harris et al., 2020 ) RandomState seeds 101, 202, 303, and 404. Each run starts with an empty episode store, fact store, and skill catalog and scores every task before writeback. Skill consolidation follows each block of 30 tasks for 20 cycles. The Full configuration uses frozen Qwen3-8B, at most 30 actions per task, and retrieval of up to four facts and two skills. Both outcome-return channels, skill creation and revision, the revisit guard, and the navigation hint remain enabled. Episodic records support skill learning but do not enter the actor’s context in this configuration. The recorded game files match each prescribed permutation exactly, with 600 distinct games and no missing tasks or environment exceptions. The four shuffled runs share one code snapshot and configuration. We report the original fixed-order result separately.
paragraphs.zh: 设置。 我们从 ALFWorld 的训练排序中重建原始的 600 局游戏池，并使用 NumPy（Harris et al., 2020）的 RandomState 种子 101、202、303 和 404 施加四次全局置换。 每次运行都以空的情节存储、事实存储和技能目录开始，并在写回之前对每个任务进行评分。 技能巩固在每 30 个任务为一组之后进行，共 20 个周期。 完整配置使用冻结的 Qwen3-8B，每个任务最多 30 个动作，并检索最多四条事实和两个技能。 两个结果返回通道、技能创建与修订、重访保护以及导航提示均保持启用。 在此配置中，情节记录支持技能学习，但不会进入 actor 的上下文。 记录的游戏文件与每个规定的置换完全一致，包含 600 局互不相同的游戏，且没有缺失任务或环境异常。 四次打乱运行共享同一份代码快照和配置。 我们单独报告原始固定顺序的结果。

paragraphs.en: Serving conditions. We evaluate three context conditions on the same 100 held-out ALFWorld games using frozen Qwen3-8B and one learned external state. The state content and retrieval statistics remain fixed throughout evaluation, with no memory writes, outcome return, or skill consolidation. All conditions retain the revisit guard, navigation hint, and 30-action limit. All conditions have a 1,024-token injected-context limit, measured with the backbone tokenizer and including block headings. MemCryst retrieves facts and skills, whereas episode replacement keeps the same facts and fills the remaining budget with retrieved episodes, including archived records. The replacement serves an average of 10.8 episodes per task. Random selection samples facts and skills from the same state while matching record types and approximate context length. Its length is within 10 % 10\% of MemCryst on every task, with a mean absolute relative deviation of 2.6 % 2.6\% . All 300 evaluations are valid, the game files match across conditions, and no injected context is truncated.
paragraphs.zh: 服务条件。 我们在相同的 100 个留出 ALFWorld 游戏上，使用冻结的 Qwen3-8B 和一个学习得到的外部状态，评估三种上下文条件。 在整个评估过程中，状态内容与检索统计保持固定，不进行记忆写入、结果回传或技能整合。 所有条件均保留重访保护、导航提示和 30 步动作上限。 所有条件的注入上下文上限均为 1,024 个 token，使用骨干模型的分词器度量，并包含区块标题。 MemCryst 检索事实和技能，而情节替换保留相同的事实，并用检索到的情节（包括归档记录）填满剩余预算。 该替换在每个任务中平均服务 10.8 个情节。 随机选择在匹配记录类型和近似上下文长度的同时，从同一状态中采样事实和技能。 其长度在每个任务上都处于 MemCryst 的 10% 以内，平均绝对相对偏差为 2.6%。 全部 300 次评估均有效，各条件之间的游戏文件保持一致，且没有任何注入上下文被截断。

paragraphs.en: Paired outcomes and actor cost. Compared with episode replacement, MemCryst alone solves 12 tasks and the replacement alone solves nine. The corresponding counts against random selection are 24 and seven. Two-sided exact McNemar tests give p = .664 p=.664 and p = .0033 p=.0033 , respectively. The episode comparison does not establish accuracy equivalence. Although all conditions share the same limit, their mean injected contexts differ: 365 tokens for MemCryst , 963 for episode replacement, and 369 for random selection. Mean actor input, including retries, is 25.9k, 36.6k, and 35.2k tokens per task in the same order. These costs cover serving the frozen state but not constructing it. This experiment is separate from both the online prequential scores and the terminal evaluation in Table 8 .
paragraphs.zh: 成对结果与智能体成本。 与情节替换相比，仅使用 MemCryst 可解决 12 个任务，而仅使用替换可解决九个任务。 相应地，针对随机选择的数量分别为 24 和七。 双侧精确 McNemar 检验分别给出 p = .664 p=.664 和 p = .0033 p=.0033。 情节比较并不能确立准确性等价。 尽管所有条件共享相同的上限，但它们注入的平均上下文不同：MemCryst 为 365 个词元，情节替换为 963 个，随机选择为 369 个。 包括重试在内的平均智能体输入，按相同顺序分别为每任务 25.9k、36.6k 和 35.2k 个词元。 这些成本涵盖了对冻结状态的使用，但不包括其构建。 该实验既不同于在线预序得分，也不同于表 8 中的终端评估。

paragraphs.en: ALFWorld: learning reusable procedures. MemCryst achieves 63.17 % 63.17\% success, compared with 49.33 % 49.33\% for MSCE and 56.17 % 56.17\% for ReAct under the same navigation settings. MSCE retrieves experience on 503 of 600 tasks but produces more invalid actions and reaches the action limit more often than either reference system. Its skill candidates include procedures tied to particular objects and destinations, which may offer little guidance when either changes. MemCryst instead learns parameterized procedures from recurring episodes and retrieves task-specific facts separately, so the same procedure can apply to different objects and destinations.
paragraphs.zh: ALFWorld：学习可复用的程序。 在相同的导航设置下，MemCryst 取得了 63.17 % 63.17\% 的成功率，而 MSCE 为 49.33 % 49.33\%，ReAct 为 56.17 % 56.17\%。 MSCE 在 600 个任务中的 503 个上检索经验，但比两个参照系统产生更多无效动作，并且更频繁地达到动作上限。 其技能候选包括与特定对象和目的地绑定的程序，当对象或目的地发生变化时，这些程序可能提供不了多少指导。 MemCryst 则从反复出现的情景中学习参数化程序，并单独检索任务相关的事实，因此同一程序可以应用于不同的对象和目的地。

paragraphs.en: DialSim: retrieving relevant facts. MemCryst reaches 74.24 % 74.24\% success, compared with 16.41 % 16.41\% for MSCE and 7.54 % 7.54\% for ReAct. The largest gap is on timed questions, where accuracy is 97.0 % 97.0\% for MemCryst and 3.2 % 3.2\% for MSCE. In the selected MSCE run, only 347 of 995 recorded retrieval results contain source conversation passages, and the actor repeats the same incorrect answer on 153 questions. MSCE selects experience by its assessed value, but these observations suggest that a useful past interaction may still lack the names or dates required by a new question. MemCryst retrieves typed facts with explicit name and date anchors to provide these details in the answer context.
paragraphs.zh: DialSim：检索相关事实。 MemCryst 达到 74.24 % 74.24\% 的成功率，相比之下 MSCE 为 16.41 % 16.41\%，ReAct 为 7.54 % 7.54\%。 差距最大的是限时问题，MemCryst 的准确率为 97.0 % 97.0\%，而 MSCE 仅为 3.2 % 3.2\%。 在所选的 MSCE 运行中，995 条记录的检索结果中仅有 347 条包含源对话段落，且该智能体在 153 个问题上重复给出同样的错误答案。 MSCE 根据评估价值选择经验，但这些观察表明，一次有用的过往交互可能仍然缺少新问题所需的姓名或日期。 MemCryst 检索带有显式姓名和日期锚点的类型化事实，以便在答案上下文中提供这些细节。

paragraphs.en: Intervention and findings. The advantage of persistent state grows when the original character names are removed from DialSim. We consistently renamed every character while preserving the dialogue structure and answers. Before running the intervention, we specified that persistent state should improve the name-substituted condition by at least 8 8 percentage points and that this gain should exceed the gain with the original names. We also expected ReAct to perform better with the original names. All three criteria were met. MemCryst ’s gain over ReAct increased from 47.0 47.0 points with the original names to 66.7 66.7 points after renaming, while ReAct fell from 26.9 % 26.9\% to 7.54 % 7.54\% . The result supports the value of retrieving deployment-specific evidence when cues associated with familiar names are unavailable.
paragraphs.zh: 干预与发现。 当从 DialSim 中移除原始角色名称时，持久状态的优势会增大。 我们在保留对话结构和答案的同时，一致性地重命名了每个角色。 在运行干预之前，我们预先设定：持久状态应使名称替换条件至少提升 8 8 个百分点，且这一增益应超过使用原始名称时的增益。 我们还预期 ReAct 在使用原始名称时表现更好。 三项标准全部满足。 MemCryst 相对于 ReAct 的增益从使用原始名称时的 47.0 47.0 分上升到重命名后的 66.7 66.7 分，而 ReAct 则从 26.9 % 26.9\% 下降到 7.54 % 7.54\% 。 这一结果支持了在与熟悉名称相关的线索不可用时检索部署特定证据的价值。

paragraphs.en: Measurement. We measure actor effort from the completed runs. For ALFWorld, logical actor calls include action steps and logged invalid-action retries on scored wake tasks, excluding held-out evaluation. For MBPP, the saved trajectories report actor steps but not a complete call counter. Both measures describe actor effort rather than total LLM cost because they exclude memory writes, synthesis, audit, and transport retries. The retrieval quotas below are configured limits, not measured token counts.
paragraphs.zh: 测量。 我们从已完成的运行中测量智能体的工作量。 对于 ALFWorld，逻辑智能体调用包括在计分唤醒任务上的动作步骤和已记录的无效动作重试，不包括保留的评估部分。 对于 MBPP，保存的轨迹报告了智能体步骤，但没有完整的调用计数器。 这两项指标描述的都是智能体的工作量，而非总的 LLM 成本，因为它们不包括记忆写入、合成、审计和传输重试。 下面的检索配额是配置的限制，而不是实测的 token 数量。

paragraphs.en: ALFWorld improves both completion and actor-call efficiency. MemCryst raises success from 51.50 % 51.50\% to 63.17 % 63.17\% while using 15.22 % 15.22\% fewer actor calls than ReAct. Figure 6 compares six configurations over 600 tasks using the original ReAct baseline. The full system uses 11,636 calls, comprising 10,975 action steps and 661 invalid-action retries. ReAct uses 13,725 calls, comprising 12,851 steps and 874 retries. Fact return alone uses slightly fewer calls at 11,612 but solves 362 tasks rather than 379. In these runs, enabling both returns therefore yields 17 more completions for 24 additional calls.
paragraphs.zh: ALFWorld 同时提升了完成率与行动调用效率。 MemCryst 将成功率从 51.50 % 51.50\% 提升至 63.17 % 63.17\%，同时行动调用次数比 ReAct 减少 15.22 % 15.22\%。 图 6 在 600 个任务上使用原始 ReAct 基线比较了六种配置。 完整系统使用了 11,636 次调用，其中包含 10,975 个行动步骤和 661 次无效行动重试。 ReAct 使用了 13,725 次调用，其中包含 12,851 个步骤和 874 次重试。 仅启用事实返回时，调用次数略少，为 11,612 次，但完成的任务为 362 个而非 379 个。 在这些运行中，同时启用两种返回因此以多出 24 次调用的代价多完成了 17 个任务。

sents.en: ALFWorld improves both completion and actor-call efficiency.
sents.zh: ALFWorld 同时提升了完成率与行动调用效率。

sents.en: MemCryst raises success from 51.50 % 51.50\% to 63.17 % 63.17\% while using 15.22 % 15.22\% fewer actor calls than ReAct.
sents.zh: MemCryst 将成功率从 51.50 % 51.50\% 提升至 63.17 % 63.17\%，同时行动调用次数比 ReAct 减少 15.22 % 15.22\%。

sents.en: Figure 6 compares six configurations over 600 tasks using the original ReAct baseline.
sents.zh: 图 6 在 600 个任务上使用原始 ReAct 基线比较了六种配置。

sents.en: The full system uses 11,636 calls, comprising 10,975 action steps and 661 invalid-action retries.
sents.zh: 完整系统使用了 11,636 次调用，其中包含 10,975 个行动步骤和 661 次无效行动重试。

sents.en: ReAct uses 13,725 calls, comprising 12,851 steps and 874 retries.
sents.zh: ReAct 使用了 13,725 次调用，其中包含 12,851 个步骤和 874 次重试。

sents.en: Fact return alone uses slightly fewer calls at 11,612 but solves 362 tasks rather than 379.
sents.zh: 仅启用事实返回时，调用次数略少，为 11,612 次，但完成的任务为 362 个而非 379 个。

sents.en: In these runs, enabling both returns therefore yields 17 more completions for 24 additional calls.
sents.zh: 在这些运行中，同时启用两种返回因此以多出 24 次调用的代价多完成了 17 个任务。

paragraphs.en: Shared successful tasks. On the 250 tasks solved by both systems, mean actor calls fall from 12.90 12.90 to 10.13 10.13 , a 21.49 % 21.49\% reduction. MemCryst uses fewer calls on 146 of these tasks, the same number on 41, and more on 63. The reduction in overall actor effort is therefore also present among tasks that both systems solve.
paragraphs.zh: 共享的成功任务。 在两个系统都解决的 250 个任务上，智能体的平均调用次数从 12.90 12.90 降至 10.13 10.13，降低了 21.49% 21.49\%。 在这些任务中，MemCryst 在 146 个任务上使用更少的调用，在 41 个任务上调用次数相同，在 63 个任务上调用更多。 因此，智能体总体工作量的减少在两个系统都能解决的任务中也同样存在。

sents.en: MemCryst uses fewer calls on 146 of these tasks, the same number on 41, and more on 63.
sents.zh: 在这些任务中，MemCryst 在 146 个任务上使用更少的调用，在 41 个任务上调用次数相同，在 63 个任务上调用更多。

paragraphs.en: MBPP context case study. Retaining episodes for learning does not require serving them on every task. Figure 7 compares two configurations on the same 252 MBPP tasks, differing only in whether past episodes enter the actor’s context. Both configurations learn online from their own trajectories and retrieve up to four facts and two skills. They use the same code execution and self-test interface, deduplicate skills, and require fact support of at least two.
paragraphs.zh: MBPP 上下文案例研究。 保留片段用于学习并不需要在每个任务上都使用它们。 图 7 在相同的 252 个 MBPP 任务上比较了两种配置，二者唯一的区别在于过去的片段是否进入智能体的上下文。 两种配置都从自身的轨迹中在线学习，并检索最多四条事实和两个技能。 它们使用相同的代码执行和自测接口，对技能去重，并要求事实至少获得两条支持。

sents.en: MBPP context case study.
sents.zh: MBPP 上下文案例研究。

sents.en: Retaining episodes for learning does not require serving them on every task.
sents.zh: 保留片段用于学习并不需要在每个任务上都使用它们。

sents.en: Figure 7 compares two configurations on the same 252 MBPP tasks, differing only in whether past episodes enter the actor’s context.
sents.zh: 图 7 在相同的 252 个 MBPP 任务上比较了两种配置，二者唯一的区别在于过去的片段是否进入智能体的上下文。

paragraphs.en: Reward and actor steps. Removing episodic context raises mean reward from 80.42 % 80.42\% to 81.22 % 81.22\% , a gain of 0.79 0.79 percentage points computed before rounding. Actor steps fall from 363 to 343, a 5.51 % 5.51\% reduction. This comparison supports keeping episodes available for learning while selecting more narrowly what enters the immediate action context.

paragraphs.en: Reader and dataset variants. For RULER and BABILong, ReAct reads only the document tail, while the external readers rebuild their stores for each document as described in Section B.4 . MemCryst retains one persistent external state across each fixed document sequence, so these comparisons evaluate complete reader systems rather than isolate memory lifetime. LongMemEval uses a reduced haystack, and DialSim-subst. denotes the name-substituted version of DialSim. LCB+ combines LiveCodeBench with a LiveCodeBench Pro extension ( Jain et al., 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2025b ) .
paragraphs.zh: 阅读器与数据集变体。 对于 RULER 和 BABILong，ReAct 仅读取文档尾部，而外部阅读器按照 B.4 节所述为每个文档重建其存储。 MemCryst 在每个固定文档序列中保持一个持久的外部状态，因此这些比较评估的是完整的阅读器系统，而非单独衡量记忆寿命。 LongMemEval 使用了缩减的海量干扰集，DialSim-subst. 表示 DialSim 的名称替换版本。 LCB+ 将 LiveCodeBench 与 LiveCodeBench Pro 扩展相结合（Jain et al., 2025；Zheng et al., 2025b）。

sents.zh: 阅读器与数据集变体。

Appendix A.3 specifies the event chronology, and Appendix B.2 reports supplementary evaluations with the final state frozen. The native reward r t r_{t} enters S preq S_{\mathrm{preq}} , whereas the binary signal y t y_{t} updates the influence of exposed records through Eqs. 9 and 10 . Table 12 specifies the scoring metric and return signal for each benchmark.

paragraphs.en: Score aggregation. Benchmark scores are percentages, and absolute differences are in percentage points. paragraphs.en: Adapter settings. For ALFWorld, MemCryst uses a navigation hint and a task-local revisit guard. If the agent holds no object and attempts to revisit a location, the guard substitutes the first valid navigation action to an unvisited location, when available. This adaptation changes within-task action execution while leaving the memory and skill update rules unchanged. The LoCoMo adapter uses BGE-M3 ( Chen et al., 2024 ) , retrieves 12 facts, and may serve verbatim excerpts within an answer budget of four steps. The code adapter retains episodic records and retrieves two deduplicated skills and four facts with support of at least two. It uses the same execution and self-test interface as ReAct.
paragraphs.zh: 适配器设置。 对于 ALFWorld，MemCryst 使用导航提示和任务局部重访守卫。 当智能体未持有物体并尝试重访某个地点时，该守卫会在可用的情况下替换为前往未访问地点的第一个有效导航动作。 这一适配仅改变任务内的动作执行，而记忆与技能更新规则保持不变。 LoCoMo 适配器使用 BGE-M3（Chen 等，2024），检索 12 条事实，并可在四步的回答预算内提供逐字摘录。 代码适配器保留情景记录，并检索两条去重后的技能和四条支持数至少为二的事实。 它使用与 ReAct 相同的执行和自测接口。

sents.en: The code adapter retains episodic records and retrieves two deduplicated skills and four facts with support of at least two.
sents.zh: 代码适配器保留情景记录，并检索两条去重后的技能和四条支持数至少为二的事实。

sents.en: It uses the same execution and self-test interface as ReAct.
sents.zh: 它使用与 ReAct 相同的执行和自测接口。

paragraphs.en: Memory writes. The episode writer turns a completed trajectory and its outcome into one JSON record containing task evidence, diagnosis, and a reusable lesson. If the call or parse fails, the writer skips the episode. The fact extractor produces typed entity and claim records, while dialogue adapters parse one entity | fact record per line. The parser drops malformed items and adds no facts from an unparseable response. A completed task can therefore update the influence of previously served records even if writing new content fails.
paragraphs.zh: 记忆写入。 轨迹写入器将一条已完成的轨迹及其结果转换为一条 JSON 记录，其中包含任务证据、诊断和可复用的经验教训。 如果调用或解析失败，写入器会跳过该轨迹片段。 事实抽取器生成带类型的实体记录和主张记录，而对话适配器则每行解析一条「实体 | 事实」记录。 解析器会丢弃格式错误的条目，且不会从无法解析的响应中添加任何事实。 因此，即使写入新内容失败，一个已完成的任务仍可更新先前已送达记录的影响力。

sents.zh: 记忆写入。

paragraphs.en: Skill writes. The synthesizer receives candidate-cluster statistics and up to five episodes with the highest weights. It returns a SKILL.md record with the required frontmatter and a parameterized procedure, which the parser rejects if it is malformed or nonparametric. The auditor then reads the complete skill proposal, cluster statistics, and the same episodes in a fresh context without the synthesis transcript. The prompt requests the 13 checks in Table 6 , and admission requires at least 10 returned PASS verdicts. The parser also rejects unparseable audit JSON. A rejected proposal does not enter the skill catalog, but the sleep pass continues with the remaining candidates.
paragraphs.zh: 技能写入。 合成器接收候选簇的统计数据以及权重最高的至多五个情节。 它返回一条带有必需前置元数据和参数化流程的 SKILL.md 记录，若该记录格式错误或无参数，解析器将拒绝它。 随后，审核员在一个不含合成过程记录的全新上下文中阅读完整的技能提案、簇统计数据以及同样的情节。 提示要求执行表 6 中的 13 项检查，准入要求至少返回 10 个 PASS 判定。 解析器也会拒绝无法解析的审核 JSON。 被拒绝的提案不会进入技能目录，但睡眠轮次会继续处理其余候选。

paragraphs.en: Inference resources. We served Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-1.7B locally on NVIDIA L40 GPUs. For the Qwen3 experiments, local inference supported task execution as well as memory writing, skill synthesis, and auditing. The GPT-4o-mini experiments used the OpenAI API with API-key authentication.

paragraphs.en: These examples show how stored experience becomes procedural guidance and context for task execution. Section D.1 presents memory records and skill snapshots from the 600-task ALFWorld run with both return channels enabled. The saved improvement fields contain the memory writer’s lessons, whereas Section D.4 presents the actual inputs and outputs of four task executions. Source wording and any truncation in the logged context are preserved, with line wrapping for readability. The cards display skill utilities and derived outcome scores as percentages. Repeated prompt blocks appear once, followed by each call’s changing input, complete response, and environment return. Task indices start at zero.
paragraphs.zh: 这些示例展示了存储的经验如何成为任务执行的过程性指导和上下文。 D.1 节展示了在同时启用两个返回通道的情况下，600 个任务的 ALFWorld 运行中的记忆记录和技能快照。 保存的改进字段包含记忆写入器的经验教训，而 D.4 节展示了四次任务执行的实际输入和输出。 记录的上下文中的原始措辞和任何截断均予以保留，并为便于阅读进行了换行处理。 这些卡片以百分比形式显示技能效用值和推导出的结果分数。 重复的提示块只出现一次，其后是每次调用的变化输入、完整响应和环境返回。 任务索引从零开始。

paragraphs.en: The cleaning and heating records link experience with different objects to persistent skills. Later skill snapshots give more direct placement guidance and require both lamp visibility and possession of the target object. The cooling example combines object-location facts with a procedure, while the dialogue example preserves the evidence needed to answer a purchase question. All four task executions include retrieved memory in the actor’s input, and ALFWorld, MATH-hard, and MBPP also include skills. These selected examples show the supplied evidence and recorded behavior without isolating the contribution of individual records.
paragraphs.zh: 清洁和加热记录将不同对象的经验与持久技能关联起来。 后面的技能快照提供了更直接的位置指引，并且同时要求灯具可见和拥有目标对象。 冷却示例将对象-位置事实与操作流程相结合，而对话示例则保留了回答购买问题所需的证据。 全部四个任务执行都在智能体的输入中包含检索到的记忆，ALFWorld、MATH-hard 和 MBPP 还包含技能。 这些选定示例展示了所提供的证据和记录的行为，但没有分离单条记录的贡献。
